notes: Structured query templates for the LinkedIn Ads audit, built against the live LinkedIn Ads (lads) schema and validated clean against a live account. Field IDs are raw (no connector prefix). Dates are NOT stored here — runtime resolves from today's date. compare_to_previous:true queries run twice (current + matching previous window) for period-over-period deltas. CRITICAL LINKEDIN PIVOT RULES (enforced by validate_query): (1) Each DEMOGRAPHICS field (job function, seniority, industry, company size, job title, country, region) must be its OWN query — demographics cannot be combined with each other. (2) DEMOGRAPHICS fields cannot be combined with CAMPAIGN / CAMPAIGN_GROUP / CREATIVE / CONVERSION fields at all (not even campaign_name). That is why audience is split into separate single-pivot queries and carries no campaign dimension. Spend (costInLocalCurrency) is in real currency, NOT micros. ROAS NOTE: return_on_spend / conversionValueInLocalCurrency populate only for value-tracking accounts; lead-gen accounts return them empty — pivot to CPL/CPA and lead/conversion volume and do NOT score ROAS. See 'Handling accounts without conversion value' in SKILL.md.

queries.title: Creative (Ad) Performance
queries.note: compare_to_previous enables creative fatigue (CTR decline vs prior period). video* / document* metrics populate only for those formats.

queries.pivot_rule: Single demographic pivot only. No campaign/creative/conversion dimensions allowed alongside it.

queries.pivot_rule: Country is a DEMOGRAPHICS-group field — must be its own single-pivot query, no campaign/creative alongside.
